🚨 GTA VI just became the biggest entertainment launch in history!

Rockstar Games says Grand Theft Auto VI pulled in $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, after more than 32 million pre-orders worldwide — a new record across any entertainment medium, beating every movie and album debut ever.

The game launched this past Thursday (Nov 19), 13 years after GTA V, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S — and already holds a record-tying 99/100 on Metacritic.

🕒 Published: 04:03 GMT+3, Nov 23

📰 Sources: Video Games Chronicle
